title: Contacts-in-Lieu Settlement of Out-of-Network Contact-Lens Claims on the Vision Plans
content:
**Settlement note — Vision Plans**

Contacts-in-lieu settles the materials of an out-of-network claim settled on its contact-lens part in this order:

1. When a contact-lens service of the same person counts in the claim's benefit period, the claim's spectacle-lens and frame lines are not reimbursed.
2. Otherwise, when the claim carries contact lenses and spectacle lenses or a frame, only the larger of two parts is reimbursed, the glasses part on a tie. The contact-lens part is the contact-lens line together with the fitting line, as the contact-lens settlement leaves them; the glasses part is the spectacle-lens and frame lines.
3. Otherwise, every line is reimbursed under its own amount.

A line left out this way is denied as contacts in lieu of glasses.

**When a contact-lens service counts.** It counts when it is the latest contact-lens service of the enrollment whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid, and its date of service falls in the same benefit period as the claim, whatever its order against it. When that latest one is the only such service on its date and has been reversed, there is taken to be none and no earlier one is looked at; of several on that date, a reversal of one leaves that date standing. A benefit period is the twelve-month period starting each year on the enrollment's benefit-period reset day, and a latest service dated in another benefit period counts nothing.

| Contact-lens service counting in the period | Claim also carries glasses | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Spectacle-lens and frame lines left out |
| No | Yes | The larger part reimbursed; glasses on a tie |
| No | No | Every line under its own amount |

*Hypothetical case.* No contact lenses were paid in the period. The claim's contact-lens part comes to 97.20 and its glasses part to 81.25, so the contact-lens part is kept and the glasses lines are denied as contacts in lieu of glasses. At equal parts the glasses part would be kept instead.
